title: bracteocarpus cumingii
intro: Bracteocarpus cumingii, commonly known as Philippine fire weed, is a plant species native to the Philippines. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bracteocarpus cumingii include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory tract infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
